text:
nina_marketing: Heads-up: got reports from webinar follow-up team that a handful of registrants landed in the wrong SDR queue this morning.

owen_ops: Looking into it now. I see a burst of leads with geo_country=null around 05:14 UTC. Connector restarted at 05:12.

enrich-bot: Alert: enrichment-worker timeout spike at 05:13:10Z (rate 7%).

parker_sales: I noticed 6 EU registrants in APAC/US queues. They already got the US timezone emails.

rachel_md: That's rough for a webinar nurture. Any chance we can undo the sends before sequences continue?

sam_engineer: Short term: we can reassign owners and pause outbound sequences. Long term: change routing fallback logic so missing geo goes to pending-enrich queue, not default round-robin.

owen_ops: Agreed. Also adding a pre-assign validation that rejects assignment if geo is empty.

sam_engineer: Reassign dry-run command:
```bash
./bin/lead-fix --start "2026-04-02T05:10:00Z" --end "2026-04-02T05:20:00Z" --validate --target pending-enrich
```
Remove --validate to apply.

nina_marketing: Please don't change owners for leads already in active cadences without flagging me + Parker.

parker_sales: Please cc me. If sequences were triggered, I might have to stop some sends manually.

owen_ops: After dry-run shows 6 candidates, I'll run the apply and notify sales + marketing. ETA 25m.

rachel_md: Also, HubSpot workflows rely on property `geo_country` for regional tagging. Can we add a fallback property `geo_inferred` so workflows don't fire on null?

sam_engineer: We can add `geo_inferred = 'unknown'` and set a workflow guard: if geo_country IS NULL -> route to enrichment and set geo_inferred. But prefer explicit enrich queue so humans can triage high-value leads.

enrich-bot: Recommendation: metric assigner.geo_null_rate and enrichment.timeout_rate should be visible on the routing dashboard.

owen_ops: Hotfix PR open: validate-geo-before-assign, adds metric and increments a prometheus counter. Will roll as 10% canary.

sam_engineer: Also updating SF sync: only push owner when owner_verified=true. Otherwise leave owner blank to avoid territory misfires in Salesforce.

nina_marketing: Action list for now:
- owen: run dry-run and then apply reassign if good (notify when applied)
- sam: merge hotfix and set canary 10%
- rachel: update HubSpot workflows to guard on geo_country null and pause affected sequences
- parker: stand by to pause/resume sends and confirm when safe

parker_sales: Acknowledge, I'll pause any cadences for the affected lead set until you confirm owner_verified.

owen_ops: Dry-run complete: 6 leads flagged (IDs: 20411,20412,20415,20418,20422,20429). Looks like webinar registrants. Applying now.

enrich-bot: Job complete: 6 leads moved to pending-enrich at 2026-04-02T05:38:40Z.

sam_engineer: Hotfix merged and canary started at 05:45 UTC (10% traffic). Added alert: if assigner.geo_null_rate > 2% for 10m then rollback canary and re-route to enrichment.

rachel_md: HubSpot workflows updated. We also added a contact list filter to capture any registrants created during the window and tag them for manual review.

nina_marketing: Thanks team. Liaise for comms if we need to notify registrants. We'll treat this as a conversion risk incident and include a quick note in the post-webinar follow-up if >5 affected.

parker_sales: Confirmed sequences paused for the 6 leads. I'll resume after owner_verified flag set.

sam_engineer: Follow-up item: add unit test for connector restart path where enrichment service returns 504. Should simulate missing geo and ensure fallback is pending-enrich, not default pool.

owen_ops: Noted. Retro scheduled 48h from now to review rollout gating for connector and enrichment interactions.

nina_marketing: Closing: reassign done, canary in place, HubSpot guards added, sales paused. We'll monitor for 24h and regroup if metric spikes. :white_check_mark:
